page.title: Register to book slots
page.description: Register your company to book loading and unloading slots at this site. Booking is free for carriers.
page.email_hint: We send a link to confirm this address.
page.sent: If the address is right, a link is on its way to {{email}}. Open it within 24 hours to finish. If you already have an account, the email asks you to sign in instead.
page.unavailable: This booking link is switched off or no longer valid. Ask the warehouse for a current link.

verify.title: Confirm your registration
verify.invalid: This link is invalid, expired or already used. Register again through the warehouse's booking link.
verify.admin_required: Only an administrator of your company can link it to a warehouse. Ask your company's administrator to register through the warehouse's booking link.
verify.sign_in_first: This email already has an account. Sign in, and the registration joins your company.
verify.no_password: No password? Request a sign-in link, sign in, then open the registration email again.
verify.continue: I signed in with the link, continue

email.expiry: The link works once and for 24 hours.
email.ignore: If you did not register, ignore this email.

verify.subject: Confirm your registration with {{tenant}}
verify.intro: You registered to book slots at {{tenant}}, {{site}}. Confirm your email address to finish.

known.subject: Sign in to finish your registration with {{tenant}}
known.intro: Someone registered this email address to book slots at {{tenant}}, {{site}}. You already have a rampflow account. Sign in and confirm, and the request joins your company.
